nodes.label: S³Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
nodes.author: Jiajun Shi et al.
nodes.rationale: Interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through Self-Testing, Self-Judging, Self-Improvement; compares History ICL, Summary Memory, parameter Training pathways across seven text-based games.

nodes.label: Self-Testing
nodes.rationale: Agent explores strategies in permissive environments, gathers diagnostic evidence through interaction.

nodes.label: Self-Judging
nodes.rationale: Agent evaluates actions, outcomes, reusability; model-generated scores compared against environment rewards; step-level agreement ~0.5-0.88 across games.

nodes.label: Self-Improvement
nodes.rationale: Experience alters future decisions via History ICL, Summary Memory, or parameter Training; evaluated on stricter held-out configurations.

nodes.label: History In-Context Learning
nodes.rationale: Score-annotated trajectories directly appended to context; preserves detailed evidence but constrained by context length (100k tokens).

nodes.label: Summary Memory
nodes.rationale: Agent compresses trajectories into reusable strategies, mistakes, directions; selective compression mechanism; not uniformly superior to raw history.

nodes.label: Parameter Training
nodes.rationale: Exploration trajectories converted to supervised fine-tuning examples; high-scoring actions retained, low-scoring filtered/corrected; enables persistent improvement but risks negative transfer.

nodes.label: Seven S³Gym Games
nodes.rationale: Chess, Minesweeper, Nullify, Tetris, Snake, Plants-vs-Zombies, Trust Evolution; cover latent-rule induction, constraint satisfaction, spatial planning, resource allocation, multi-agent strategy.

nodes.label: Exploration and Evaluation Phases
nodes.rationale: Exploration uses permissive configurations; evaluation uses stricter rules; disjoint seeds; evaluation trajectories not added to experience.

nodes.label: Judgment-Improvement Coupling
nodes.rationale: Blockwise correlation ρ(A,g)=-0.010, ρ(-E,g)=-0.018; accurate local scoring does not reliably produce improvement; agents must transform feedback into reusable abstractions.

nodes.label: Parameter Training Results
nodes.rationale: Qwen3-8B: substantial gains on Trust Evolution (AUC+=163.5), limited on Chess/Snake, no improvement on Minesweeper/Nullify/Tetris, severe negative transfer on PvZ (23→6).

nodes.label: GPT-4o
nodes.rationale: Proprietary LLM evaluated on S³Gym; representative baseline for self-improvement capability.

nodes.label: Gemini-3.5-Flash
nodes.rationale: Strongest on Chess (History ICL), Snake, Trust Evolution; demonstrates model-dependent self-improvement effectiveness.

nodes.label: GPT-5.5
nodes.rationale: Strongest on Minesweeper, Nullify, Tetris, PvZ (History ICL); leads on Chess, Nullify, Tetris (Summary Memory).

nodes.label: S3GYM: Self-Improving Game Benchmark
nodes.author: Jiajun Shi, Siyuan Tao, Yuhao Wu, Zexuan Wang, Jingyuan Zhang
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for measuring LLM self-improvement through interaction history reuse and score-conditioned summaries in game environments

nodes.label: Summary Memory
nodes.rationale: Score-conditioned strategy compression that converts interaction history into executable iteration directions; effective when experience admits compact causal abstractions

nodes.label: Direct History In-Context Learning
nodes.rationale: Raw trajectory reuse without compression; performs better in reactive control games where state-contingent details are critical

nodes.label: RQ1: Score-Conditioned Summaries vs Direct History
nodes.rationale: Comparative evaluation showing Summary Memory improves NABA on Nullify, Tetris, Trust; direct history better on Minesweeper, PvZ, Snake

nodes.label: Summary Memory Effectiveness Conditions
nodes.rationale: Summary Memory effective when: (1) score identifies meaningful reusable failure mode, (2) summary converts signal into action rule precise enough to execute in new state

nodes.label: Chess Game Environment
nodes.rationale: Piece-position prediction game; direct history outperforms summary memory due to multi-piece localization requirements

nodes.label: Tetris Game Environment
nodes.rationale: Line-clearing game; summary memory most effective with ∆NABA = +6.20, benefits from compact look-ahead rules

nodes.label: Minesweeper Game Environment
nodes.rationale: Constraint-satisfaction game; direct history outperforms summary memory due to local board configuration importance

nodes.label: Trust Evolution Game Environment
nodes.rationale: Repeated interaction game; summary memory most effective with ∆NABA = +8.43, benefits from opponent-strategy inference

nodes.label: S3GYM Seven Games
nodes.rationale: Chess, Minesweeper, Nullify, PvZ, Snake, Tetris, Trust; test whether LLMs can reuse interaction history for self-improvement

nodes.label: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
nodes.author: Noah Shinn et al.
nodes.rationale: Verbal reinforcement learning for agent improvement; related to trajectory reuse in S3GYM

nodes.label: KORGym: Dynamic Game Platform
nodes.author: Jiajun Shi et al.
nodes.rationale: Game platform for LLM reasoning evaluation; related to S3GYM game environments
